what_changed: CFPB revises the date of applicability of its Regulation F medical debt advisory opinion (89 FR 80715) to January 2, 2025.
compliant_agent_must_now: Third-party collectors only: if the advisory opinion applies to the deployment's debts, comply with it from January 2, 2025 instead of December 3, 2024.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the deployment collect any medical debt, or only consumer loans? If only consumer loans, does the opinion's reading of 12 CFR 1006.18 and 1006.22 change any existing collection script?
rationale: Applicability-date change to the Reg F medical debt advisory opinion; relevance follows that opinion, whose reach beyond medical debt is unresolved. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
